title: Dress form (scan, bust 91 cm)
source: Photogrammetry scan of a women's torso form supplied by the founder; origin not stated. Straightened, scaled to the founder's girths, cut above the scan's base artifact and decimated to 24,000 triangles in Blender (scripts/avatar/prepare_dressform.py in the Darts repository).
license: unknown: not for redistribution until the origin is confirmed
provenance: Scale fitted to bust, waist and hip girths (2.9 percent spread); neck, neck-to-waist and waist-to-hip are checks. Front chosen by the hip-versus-waist test and confirmed on renders.

knots.name: hip
knots.basis: widest girth below the waist, found on the scan by prepare_dressform.py

knots.name: waist
knots.basis: narrowest girth between hip and bust, found on the scan

knots.name: underbust
knots.basis: ASSUMED: 7 cm below the bust line. The scan has no distinct under-bust feature

knots.name: bust
knots.basis: widest girth above the waist, found on the scan

knots.name: neck
knots.basis: 95.5 percent of the full scan height, where the neck is taken for back waist length; a tapered neck has no single girth
